open_cases.outcome_and_obstacle: Reach a trustworthy accountable decision sooner. The observed queue is at the single decision owner; qualified alternatives lack authority. Faster summaries do not by themselves change that decision capacity.

candidates.mechanism: Explicitly delegate a bounded class of decision rights to one available qualified owner and route eligible requests to that owner.
candidates.changed_assumption: Only the overloaded incumbent may make an accountable decision.
candidates.how_it_improves_outcome: It can increase effective decision capacity while recording a named accountable approver and reason for every request. Define eligibility and exception escalation before testing; no approval is removed.

candidates.mechanism: Give the incumbent a protected decision session and queue ready requests for that session, retaining individual approval records.
candidates.changed_assumption: Decision throughput must operate through fragmented attention and uncontrolled interruptions.
candidates.how_it_improves_outcome: It could reduce coordination and context-switching overhead without changing authority. This is useful only if that overhead contributes to the backlog; the supplied observations do not establish it, and batching can itself add waiting.

candidates.mechanism: Use a short decision-ready intake checklist with a stated decision, missing facts, acceptance criteria, and exception flags.
candidates.changed_assumption: Every fast summary is already complete enough for the accountable owner to decide.
candidates.how_it_improves_outcome: If decisions stall on missing facts or rework, completing those facts before owner review could reduce decision service time. This is a conditional hypothesis, not an observed deficiency in the summaries.

open_cases.selected_test: Test bounded delegation first because it addresses the observed authority bottleneck. In a short pilot, use comparable eligible requests arriving in the same window and alternate their assignment between the incumbent and one qualified owner granted explicit rights for that class. Keep summary production, acceptance rules, and accountable approval requirements identical. Record readiness time, owner-wait time, decision time, owner, reason, and any defect or rework under the same predeclared quality review. Include pilot setup and total request time so waiting is not merely moved upstream. Compare whether the delegated route reduces owner waiting and total trustworthy-decision time while retaining every required approval. This is a proposed feasibility and causal-discrimination pilot, with no claimed statistical power or observed result.
open_cases.refutation_condition: The proposed pilot fails its claim if delegation cannot preserve accountable rights and approval quality, or if it produces no shorter owner waiting and total trustworthy-decision time on comparable requests. If delays persist mainly in obtaining facts or another shared stage, that weakens the single-owner capacity explanation and motivates a different mechanism. A small ambiguous pilot is inconclusive rather than evidence of universal failure.
open_cases.evidence_limit: Only the supplied qualitative observations are known. No arrival rates, service times, actual authority grant, pilot measurements, or quality results exist here. Improving the summary generator remains possible only with new evidence that preparation contributes materially to the desired outcome.

open_cases.outcome_and_obstacle: Help the user complete the task with a suitable amount of investigation. Structural dispatch validity does not identify which method improves the task outcome, and the two possible task types have different information needs.

candidates.mechanism: Use an acceptance check followed by direct execution for an exact, bounded correction.
candidates.changed_assumption: A catalog method must run before any useful action can occur.
candidates.how_it_improves_outcome: When the requested change and affected scope are known, make the smallest correction and inspect the affected behavior. Exit when the acceptance condition passes and no relevant unresolved dependency remains. If the inspection exposes wider interactions or an unclear requirement, stop this direct path and escalate only that uncertainty.

candidates.mechanism: Perform a short uncertainty triage, select one mechanism that can distinguish the leading explanations, and expand only when evidence requires it.
candidates.changed_assumption: Every task needs the same breadth of investigation regardless of what is unknown.
candidates.how_it_improves_outcome: For a multilayer contradiction, name the conflicting claims and the smallest evidence needed to reconcile them, then use an applicable method with an explicit stopping condition. Exit after a supported resolution meets the acceptance criteria; return to the direct path if triage reveals only a local exact correction. Valid catalog structure alone is insufficient for method selection.

candidates.mechanism: Retain a bounded all-sixteen-method comparison when exhaustive method comparison is itself an accepted research deliverable.
candidates.changed_assumption: Running all methods must be either mandatory for every task or forbidden altogether.
candidates.how_it_improves_outcome: On a multilayer contradiction chosen for an explicitly exhaustive comparison, the incumbent can satisfy the coverage requirement. Preserve a consolidated conflict and evidence map, the distinct contribution or redundancy of each method, unresolved claims, and execution burden. Apply a stated budget and record incomplete coverage if it is exhausted. For an ordinary exact correction without this research requirement, exit to the direct intervention instead.

open_cases.selected_test: Use a two-case bounded pilot: one exact static correction with a known acceptance check and one multilayer contradiction with predeclared conflicting claims and a requested exhaustive research comparison. For the correction, compare direct execution against the incumbent all-method route on identical copies and check accepted behavior, extra changes, elapsed effort, and user interruptions. For the contradiction, run the incumbent within its research budget and preserve its consolidated map; compare that result with a triage-selected path from the same starting evidence. Separate ordinary task resolution from the explicit exhaustive-coverage deliverable when comparing them, since the short route cannot claim sixteen-method coverage. Record distinct supported findings and unresolved contradictions rather than treating output volume or dispatch validity as outcome evidence. This is a proposed test and no methods have been executed by this answer.
open_cases.refutation_condition: The direct route is inadequate for its stated applicability if it fails the exact acceptance check or misses a relevant dependency that a broader route identifies. Triage is inadequate if it exits with an unresolved required contradiction that the full comparison resolves within the accepted budget. The incumbent has no demonstrated added value for ordinary task resolution if its extra runs yield no distinct supported finding while consuming more effort. Failure to complete the requested exhaustive coverage within the budget refutes completion of that research deliverable, not the utility of every individual method.
open_cases.evidence_limit: The catalog has stipulated structural validity but no task outcome evidence. No particular method is asserted to be effective or ineffective. The exhaustive research objective is an explicit condition introduced for a task where the incumbent is justified; a multilayer task alone does not establish that all sixteen methods are necessary.
